KJZZ's Oct. 6, 2026 CD5 profile mentions no legal matter.

networth.note: Both reports list no reportable assets and no liabilities, so the reportable net worth is zero; a personal home and small accounts below thresholds are not reported.

note.t: No reportable assets or liabilities. Earned income: her consulting firm Executive Fertility Consultants ($2,300 in 2025; she is principal/CEO); spouse salary from Valleywise Health ($102,218 in 2025). Agreement: a 401(k) from former employer CNY Fertility (since Sept. 2018). Both reports (filing years 2025 and 2026) were filed on June 6, 2026. No foreign assets or income.
